feature_contract.goal: Keep the original ESC/pause menu shell, queued child text and YES/NO option arrows together on one correctly scaled, vertically offset stereo optical plane under headset motion without changing gameplay HUD.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R84 paused ESC menu source-owned shader and XYZRHW rendering only. Do not alter generic menus, world/sky, SkyGlow, gameplay UI, F11, rank, GOAL/+TIME, original game input, FFB, or R26_SAFE.
trace_stages: Game STATE_SMPAUSEMENU produces original queued generic overlay text and exact pause-arrow ScreenHud with a distinct native SpriteNode.
R84 R30ClassifyScreenSpacePass admits only the live queued ESC owner and R30GetRecentOriginalHudWvp validates original same-node/pose/shader WVP.
R30BuildScreenSpaceEyeConstants reconstructs a finite per-eye HUD plane and applies the identical pause scale and post-projection offset to ESC text and arrows.
subcomponents: Admit only source-proven paused generic queued text to the existing ESC shader optical scale after exact WVP lifetime verification.
Apply the same pause vertical clip shift as the exact shader-owned option arrows and protect unrelated producer modes through negative C++ and source-mutation regression tests.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: ESC menu original queued text and exact arrows optical convergence
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Both the queued pause text and ScreenHud arrows use a common responsive pause optical size and post-eye vertical shift on the real R84 shader GPU path.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Non-pause menu/world/gameplay HUD and invalid source WVP
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Generic unqueued or non-pause overlay cannot gain pause transforms; bad source identity preserves the original single draw.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Source-integrated Windows game and host packaging
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Same validation-bearing Git SHA passes DX9Ex Active, Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector, Full Source Impact without CI skip and HMD remains separately untested.

diagnosis.original_evidence: The existing R84 finite HUD shader case admits both exact ScreenHud and source-proven queued ScreenOverlay2D, but exactPauseShaderOwner was exactHud && R30IsPauseMenuElement(), so queued ESC text used R30HudScaleValue and zero pause vertical shift while exact pause arrows used separate menu controls.
source_trace: In SMPAUSEMENU an exact producer tags option arrow ScreenHud but generic queued shell/child text remains ScreenOverlay2D.
R30ClassifyScreenSpacePass conditionally admits only same-node queued perspective generic pause overlay and R30GetRecentOriginalHudWvp requires current shader, pose and original game WVP.
R30BuildScreenSpaceEyeConstants uses exactPauseShaderOwner to choose pause scale and post-eye shift; generic queued path previously set it false.
diagnosis.root_cause: Pause shader transform permission covered ScreenHud arrows but excluded the independently source-proven queued ScreenOverlay2D ESC text even when both entered the same finite stereo plane.
alternatives_rejected: Do not broaden all ScreenOverlay2D, generic non-pause overlays or F11 into finite eye HUD owner.
Do not duplicate existing D3DX deferred producer hooks, suppress sprites or globally flush native queues.
Do not modify the R26_SAFE fallback or weaken shader/pose/WVP provenance checks.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: C++ R84 pause finite-plane permission includes genericQueuedHud while retaining R30IsPauseMenuElement; five-way static smoke cases and negative mutation guard cover external/nonpause/untagged cases.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Existing R30 per-eye pose/projection and post-projection pause offset remain unchanged; both exact arrow and source-verified queue child now use the same pause size/shift owner.
diagnosis.evidence_limit: No Quest3/VDXR visual test. Not a claim that every ESC controller-navigation/hitbox scenario is fully accepted; only the identified text/shell stereo mismatch is a source-fix candidate.
